conversation.message: Let’s structure the earnings work around readiness, investor communication, and the board narrative.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: We can keep the appendix tightly linked to the main discussion and identify any figures that need explicit explanation.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I held the board preview meeting for the Q3 earnings last week.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives the team a useful basis for refining emphasis and addressing any points that require sharper communication.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want the final review to stay focused on the few messages that matter most to stakeholders.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Agreed. We can review the headline messages first, then test whether the supporting material answers likely questions without diluting the core story.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please organize the remaining work into a concise executive checklist.
